name: Ishita Rao
why: I want a team that builds briefs backwards from data, not from a mood board.
admire: A regional food creator who turned a recipe series into a sell-out spice brand. Specific audience, specific promise.
problem: Pick a mid-size appliance brand. Problem: high reach, low branded search. I would brief Kannada and Tamil creators on one use case and track search lift, not views.

name: Karthik Subramanian
why: I have built Tamil creator lists for two campaigns and want to do it with a team that measures cost per view, not likes.
admire: A Tamil tech reviewer whose honest reviews drive sell-outs. Trust beats reach.
problem: A fintech app with weak trust in Tier 2 Tamil Nadu. Use local creators who explain one feature in Tamil, and track installs by pin code.

name: Sneha Kulkarni
why: I ran hiring for a 40-person startup and cut our offer turnaround from 9 days to 3. I want to do that on a bigger funnel.
admire: A hiring campaign where a brand let employees film their real day. Honest beats polished.
problem: An edtech brand with poor trust after layoffs. Use teachers as creators to show real classrooms, and track demo bookings.

name: Rohan Desai
why: I edit for retention. I want to work where someone actually reads the retention graph with me.
admire: A mattress brand's 6-second cut that showed the product before the logo.
problem: A D2C snack brand with good reach but weak repeat orders. Cut creator videos around one craving moment and test three hooks.

name: Meera Iyer
why: I want to move from servicing to strategy.
admire: A bank's regional language campaign that explained FDs through family stories.
problem: A healthcare chain with low awareness outside metros. Use doctors who create content in Malayalam and track appointment bookings.

name: Zoya Shaikh
why: I write hooks in Hinglish that people quote back to me. I want to write them for brands that track saves.
admire: A food delivery brand's push notifications. Ten words, one joke, one order.
problem: A sunscreen brand people think is only for beaches. Script creators applying it before a Mumbai local train ride, and track repeat buys.

name: Arjun Nair
why: I have closed media deals on reach. I want to sell outcomes clients can audit.
admire: An appliance brand that sold a fan on electricity savings, not looks.
problem: A home loan company with high cost per lead. Use finance creators to explain one EMI myth, and track leads by city.

name: Tanvi Joshi
why: I like shoots that run on time. I want a studio that plans like an agency.
admire: A one-take product demo shot in a real kitchen.
problem: A cookware brand seen as expensive. Shoot real home cooks, one dish, one price-per-use line.

name: Vikram Reddy
why: I manage 12 Telugu creators today and want a team that pays them on time.
admire: A Telugu comedy creator who made a bank ad people shared for the joke.
problem: A two-wheeler EV brand with range anxiety in Andhra. Creators ride a real daily route on camera and share the battery left.

name: Ananya Pillai
problem: Any brand can grow with influencers.

name: Siddharth Jain
why: I closed books in 4 days at my last agency. I want to make creator payments boringly reliable.
admire: A brand that published its creator payment terms. Trust as a feature.
problem: A creator platform with payment complaints. Fix the payout calendar before spending on ads.

name: Fatima Ansari
why: I like turning vague client asks into plans with dates on them.
admire: A mattress brand's sleep-trial creator series. One promise, many proofs.
problem: A water purifier brand losing to cheaper rivals. Show the cost of one illness against the filter price, through doctor creators.

name: Nikhil Menon
why: I re-cut my own videos after reading retention graphs. Most editors don't look.
admire: A phone brand's Shorts that open on the problem, not the phone.
problem: An earphone brand seen as cheap. Cut creator videos around one sound moment and test three hooks.

name: Divya Shetty
why: I track why some Kannada creators blow up and others don't. I want to learn the business side.
admire: A Kannada creator who reviews street food with prices on screen.
problem: A local coffee brand unknown outside Karnataka. Creators do a 7-day filter coffee switch and show the cost per cup.

name: Pooja Naik
why: I have hired 40 people in a year. I want to fix the funnel, not only fill it.
admire: A company that sent rejected candidates real feedback. People remembered.
problem: A gym chain with high trial drop-off. Members film week 1 honestly and the brand tracks week-4 retention.
